alt: A hostile run-in with security allows you to score some Paragon or Renegade points,
after which Parasini will refer you to Anoleis for the clearance you need to leave Port Hanshan.
Talk to a hanar merchant named Opold to start the assignment “Noveria: Smuggling”.
Go pick up Opold’s Package to give yourself more options while in Port Hanshan.
You can nark on Opold to get the garage pass you need from Anoleis,
but if you refuse to do so, Parasini will suggest you talk to Lorik Qui’in.
Talk to Mallene Calis to start the assignment “Noveria: Espionage”,
while if you do what Parasini suggested and talk to Lorik, he’ll ask you to recover some incriminating evidence on Anoleis.
Pass a Charm/Intimidate check to convince some guards to leave.
Pass a Charm/Intimidate check to convince some guards to leave.
You’ll still end up having to fight through several ERCS Guards and their pet drone.
Most of the guards are nondescript, but one at least will use tech attacks on you.
Loot the Synthetic Insights building,
then head upstairs and download the data from Lorik’s computer.
Start out the fight with Kaira and her goons by debilitating them with tech attacks and quickly ducking out of sight to avoid sniper fire.
After the initial onslaught, troublesome foes can be controlled with biotics.
After you have Lork’s data, you can give it to Anoleis for the garage pass you need.
Alternatively, you can give the data to Lorik.
Talk to Parasini and she’ll tell you her angle,
Talk to Parasini and she’ll tell you her angle,
after which you can convince Lorik to testify against Anoleis with a Charm/Intimidate check.
After you convince Lorik to testify, tell Parasini and she’ll take care of Anoleis.
If you talk to Parasini, you can inform Anoleis about her to get Parasini “fired”.
When you finally reach the garage, you’ll find the Benezia has left some “gifts” for you.
